plain: A scientist named Kevin Knuth, speaking on a podcast about NASA, the US space agency, tells how a set of NASA files belonging to a man named Scott Simpkinson came to light. Knuth says that after Simpkinson and a woman named Emily Erdle had both died, the files went up for auction, a man named Ed Wilson bought them, and among them he found a lithograph, a kind of printed image. The story matters to Knuth because, as he tells it, the files held material NASA had never shared.
